review_type: independent fixed-revision source/reference review, resx/translation-table audit, native image inspection and CI status check
verdict: Run 23 closes most of round 22's CurrentState gap. HIGH_LATENCY and HIGH_LATENCY2 decoding matches CurrentState.cs field by field. HIGH_LATENCY2 now selects the target with the original 2/4 count rule, auto-property zero defaults are applied, and the IMU magnitudes are implemented. Localization moves from English-only to 17 cultures loaded from the original resx files, with the original restart flow. The English-keyed text map has no context, though. It is applied to data values and to menus that the original translates per control. That produces wrong output in several non-English cultures: '0' displays as '5' in ja-JP/id-ID, the PLAN 'Loiter' submenu shows 'Manual' in zh-Hans, and '&RTL' mnemonics render literally. Coverage is also incomplete. Overall progress is real, but these defects, the stale captures and the unchanged platform, video, plugin and transport gaps keep 10/10 out of reach.

scores.scale: Qualitative exact-original parity scores, not completion percentages. Overall equally weights UI/UX and features, rounded down from 8.75 because of the new non-English data-display regressions. UI/UX credits localization moving from absent to broad but imperfect. Features credits high-latency decoding/identity, source defaults and magnitudes. English-culture behavior is unchanged because tr() passes text through when no table is active.

rationale: HIGH_LATENCY (state.rs:503-529) and HIGH_LATENCY2 (state.rs:530-557) reproduce CurrentState.cs:2445-2573. That covers the custom-mode gate and mode lookup, /100 attitude, the altasl-HomeAlt alt, the alt_error setter's targetalt smoothing with banker's rounding, the *2 and /5 scales, wp_dist*10, and the retained climb_rate*10 factor. It also keeps the currentbit==1 quirk, so only GPS failure text appears. Link identity (link.rs:1030-1043, 1075-1158) follows MAVLinkInterface.cs:866-925 and 1168-1183: HIGH_LATENCY2 from non-GCS, non-zero compids, 2 sightings for compid 1 and 4 otherwise, with CurrentState populated before Connected. The new wire test checks the GCS/compid-0 exclusions, the counts and the home-relative alt. accelsq/gyrosq/magfield 1-3 match CurrentState.cs:556-692. AUTO_DEFAULTS are all zero, and CurrentState.cs has no non-zero auto-property initializer, so the defaults are faithful. Localization reads real resx data, and the per-form ApplyResources path for 30 Designer forms is faithful, including the rangefinder sample (声呐, 距离:, 电压:). Backstage labels such as 声呐 match InitialSetup.zh-Hans.resx:166-167. The ConfigPlanner combo offers the 17 cultureCodes, saves 'language', shows 'Please Restart the Planner' and closes, as in ConfigPlanner.cs:106-133 and 417-425 and MainV2.cs:4227-4257. The cross-form English-to-culture map is where the problems come from. Its votes resolve per-control conflicts arbitrarily (39 ko-KR, 20 zh-Hans, 21 ja-JP and 26 de-DE keys have conflicting translations). It keeps WinForms '&' mnemonics, which MyButton strips (MyButton.cs:148-151). It contains non-label numerics ('0' to '5' from FlightData playback controls in ja-JP/id-ID). And theme::label now passes every string through it, values included.

run23_dispositions.closed_parts: All fields assigned by CurrentState.cs:2445-2573 are ported with the same scales. That covers the mode gate (base_mode CUSTOM_MODE_ENABLED for HL; unknown modes keep the previous mode), landed, ch3percent, targetairspeed, climbrate (HL2 *10 retained), airspeed1_temp, failsafe, wpno, wp_dist, wind and gpshdop. targetalt follows the alt_error setter (CurrentState.cs:1104-1113). Unit tests cover both messages, the mode gate and the unknown-mode case.
run23_dispositions.remaining: messageHigh uses a hard-coded 'ERROR GPS ' where the original uses Strings.ERROR, which is localized (state.rs:543 vs CurrentState.cs:2551-2552). HL alt_error recomputes targetalt every packet; C# skips this when the value is unchanged. Both are minor.

run23_dispositions.closed_parts: HIGH_LATENCY2 from a non-GCS, non-zero compid is counted per (sysid, compid). Compid 1 connects at 2 sightings, others at 4, as in MAVLinkInterface.cs:905-925. Firmware/mavtype are set as in SetupMavConnect(hl) (MAVLinkInterface.cs:1168-1183), and Connected is published after CurrentState is populated. The MAV list gets HL2 entries (cf. MAVLinkInterface.cs:5372-5398). The wire-level TCP test covers GCS and compid-0 rejection, both counts, home-relative alt and component isolation.
run23_dispositions.remaining: The HEARTBEAT path still connects on the first heartbeat, where the original needs the same 2/4 counts (pre-existing). The original MAVlist also admits GCS-type HL2 senders (type check commented out at 5378). That one is minor.

run23_dispositions.area: CurrentState auto-property defaults and IMU magnitudes
run23_dispositions.closed_parts: AUTO_DEFAULTS is exported from every numeric/bool auto-property; gen_speed and capabilities now read 0, matching C# language defaults. voltageflag=1 follows ResetInternals (CurrentState.cs:4498). accelsq/2/3 (/1000), gyrosq/2/3, magfield/2/3, watts, vlen, verticalspeed_fpm and timeInAirMinSec are implemented. No non-zero auto-property initializer exists in CurrentState.cs.
run23_dispositions.remaining: Computed getters are still not ported, e.g. ch1percent/ch3percent derived from SERVO params with a -1 sentinel (CurrentState.cs:66-67, 939-1000). verticalspeed is VFR climb in Rust but the alt-derivative in the alt setter in C# (CurrentState.cs:336-349). A full property-by-property fixture audit is still absent.

run23_dispositions.closed_parts: Offers the 17 original cultureCodes with display names, saves Settings 'language', shows 'Please Restart the Planner' and closes. The culture is applied at startup from Settings, and per-culture tables are embedded.

new_regression_findings.area: Context-free text map applied to data values
new_regression_findings.finding: theme::label now runs every string through i18n::t (theme.rs:573-576), including values. ja-JP and id-ID map '0' to '5', plus '0.1'/'0.25'/'0.5' to fractions; the entries come from FlightData playback-speed control resources. Param Compare (config.rs:620-622) therefore shows a parameter value of 0 as 5, and so do the servo PWM readout (flight_data.rs:2082), the log-download count (flight_data.rs:1757), the map-cache count (hotkey_tools.rs:165) and Warning Manager values (tool_windows.rs:866-867). The Formation grid mode cell (more_tools.rs:468) maps vehicle mode names: Loiter shows as 手动/手動/РУЧНОЙ ('Manual') in zh-Hans/zh-TW/ru-RU and as '&Manual'-style text in es/fr/it/pl, and Land shows as 'Tanah' ('soil') in id-ID. The original shows these values untranslated.

The exporter keeps one translation per English string (export_translations.py:114), with ties broken by glob order. zh-Hans 'Loiter' has 手动 (FlightData BUT_quickmanual, a stale 'Manual'), 留待 and Loiter留待 at one vote each. The PLAN right-click Loiter submenu (menu.rs:253) therefore shows 手动 where FlightPlanner.zh-Hans.resx:480-481 has Loiter留待. ko-KR 'Load File' shows 파일 불러오기 where FlightPlanner.ko-KR.resx:1436-1437 has 파일 로드. de 'Name' becomes 'Komando'. 39 ko-KR, 20 zh-Hans, 21 ja-JP and 26 de-DE English keys have conflicting original translations. PLAN grid headers from mavcmd.xml (flight_plan.rs:624) are translated, though the original sets them in English at runtime (FlightPlanner.cs:2024-2033).
de/es/fr/it/pl tables contain '&RTL', '&Auto' and '&Manual...' (FlightData quick buttons). MyButton removes the first '&' before drawing (MyButton.cs:148-151); theme::button_sized draws it.

new_regression_findings_limit: Found by source and data inspection; no affected-culture render exists. English behavior is unaffected. Not an exhaustive defect list.

ten_out_of_ten_criterion: An honest 10 requires no known material software discrepancy within the promised exact-clone scope, plus adequate decoder, interaction and native-platform evidence. Run 23 closes the high-latency/defaults gap and makes localization exist. The localization itself now shows wrong data and wrong menu text in several cultures, misses strings the original translates, and has no capture from the reviewed binary. Mobile runtime, video, plugins and transports remain open. Physical flight qualification is separate from this software parity score.
